answers.core: Decisions on what functions shouldn't ever return a value that needs to be processed need to be made carefully so as to avoid each project reporting different errors, confusing developers.
answers.workaround: Yes, you could add an ignore warning comment for every single function like `connect` that shouldn't return an erroneous value that must be processed programmatically, however, this is prone to error when you have a lot of warnings built up in a project ( you may ignore the actual errors ) and slows down development time.

title: Add capability to "filter" certain functions out of the warning linter that don't return a value that needs to be processed
